what: First-person LEFT forearm + EVA glove with a wrist screen. The right arm is the same model mirrored (scale.x = -1, double-sided, hide the WristScreen meshes).
how_to_pose: Each animation is a held pose. Play all of them and crossfade their weights.
axes_in_threejs: As exported the arm points +Z from elbow to hand and the back of the hand faces +Y. Rotate 180 deg about Y to point it forward.

materials.Glove: vertex colours (COLOR_0, linear) measured from the Z-2 suit; UV.x = 1 marks the wrist ring (player colour); 1 - UV.y is the cloth class (1 sleeve cloth, 0.5 glove cloth, 0 rubber/metal) that drives the soot and dust in ARM_FRAG
materials.Screen: one quad with 0-1 UVs; put a canvas / UI texture on it (flipY = false)

gestures_in_camera_space.note: elbow position, arm direction, back-of-hand direction (x right, y up, z toward the viewer), finger pose

screen.R: solved every frame: the right index fingertip (arm-local [-0.051,-0.012,-0.571] in the 'point' pose) is placed on the selected screen row, 14 mm above the glass (1 mm during a tap), with the arm approaching from the right and 0.21 m above the screen plane so nothing passes through the left arm. See arms.tapTarget() in src/main.js.

credit: Arm, glove and wrist screen modelled for Marswalk (procedural, Blender).

wrist_screen.note: arm-local = after the 180 deg flip: x across the screen (toward the viewer's bottom edge), y out of the glass, z from hand to elbow

rest_pose.space: torso (yaw only), then rotated by the look pitch clamped to -0.3..0.45 rad, so the gloves sit at the bottom edge at level gaze and rise as you look down

clips.file: arm_clips.glb (skeleton + animations only, no mesh; bone names match arm_left.glb, so the clips play on the arm's own AnimationMixer)

common.needs: sample_scoop.glb parented to the 'hand' bone (see assets_props/props.json)
common.space: camera space: while the clip plays, set the arm group to position 0 / no rotation; the 'forearm' root bone carries the whole motion
common.start_end: exactly the 'tool' hold placement, so the clip can take over and hand back without a jump; set all pose weights to 0 while it plays ('fist' is baked into the clip)

collect_rock.camera: bends: eye height 1.70 -> 1.15 m, 0.20 m forward, pitch 35 deg down, then stands
collect_rock.use: take chips from a low rock such as Cheyava Falls
collect_rock.stand: feet 0.70 m from the rock face, facing it; the scoop tip meets the rock about 0.3 m above the ground

collect_ground.camera: crouches: eye height 1.70 -> 0.84 m, 0.28 m forward, pitch 55 deg down, then stands
collect_ground.use: scoop loose soil from the ground
collect_ground.slope: add (ground height 0.47 m ahead - ground height at the feet) to the camera height while crouched, so the scoop meets the soil on slopes

camera_track.bone: camrig (in arm_clips.glb; it is not a bone of arm_left.glb, so play its tracks on a separate dummy node named 'camrig')
camera_track.read: position.y = height offset in metres (negative = lower), position.z = metres forward, angle from its first-frame rotation = pitch down in radians
camera_track.apply: camera height += offset; camera moves forward along the heading; pitch = mix(player pitch, clip pitch, clip pitch / its maximum: 0.96 rad for collect_ground, 0.61 rad for collect_rock)
camera_track.reference: arms.play and the 'cc' lines in tick() in src/main.js

clips.not_in_clip: dust puff, the mark left in the soil, the first-person legs (hidden in the test bench while crouched), the player's shadow while crouched
